tags.name: Admin Zones
tags.description: Delivery zones (PostGIS polygons). Admin JWT. Assign restaurants via PUT /admin/zones/restaurant/{restaurantId}.

PlaceOrderRequest.description: Checkout payload. Use saved address via delivery_address_id, or inline address fields when no id. For delivery, distance (km) is required. Cart checkout: omit items/cart and use DB cart; buy-now: set is_buy_now true with items (or cart array). Guest checkout: send guest_id from POST /consumer/guest/request when not using Bearer token.

guest_id.description: Guest id when placing without login

price.description: Optional for buy-now; server uses menu price when loading from cart DB

address.description: Required for delivery if delivery_address_id omitted

cart_id.description: Order only this cart row when not buy-now

guest_id.description: Required for guest checkout when no Bearer token

total_ammount.description: Legacy PHP field name (subtotal + tax + delivery before tips in response helper)

zone_id.description: Recommended: first id from JSON.parse(zone_id) after GET /consumer/config/zone-id; must match pin lat/lng

role.description: Partner type applying (not the consumer user role)

cloudflareId.description: Send as cloudflare_id on upload and register/apply

msg.example: Upload prefix ready. Upload files then pass cloudflare_id on register.

path.description: Prefer this on register/apply JSON (fits DB VarChar)

CloudflareRegistrationId.description: Same value from POST /storage/registration-init; links uploads to the new vendor/driver row

msg.example: Registration successful! Please wait for admin approval.

image.description: Step 1 — portrait / identity photo path (POST /upload category=profile)

identity_image.description: Step 2 — ID document path(s) (POST /upload category=identity). String or array of 1–2 paths.

delivery_type.description: Step 2 — Select Delivery Type (use with or instead of earning)

closed.description: true = temporarily closed; false = open for orders

meta_image.description: URL or R2 path from POST /upload

token.description: Google id token or access token when login_type=social

access_token.description: Set to 1 or true if token is OAuth access token (not id token)

guest_id.description: Optional guest id to merge cart on login

token.description: Google id token from mobile/web SDK (default)

access_token.description: Set to 1 or true when token is an OAuth access token

guest_id.description: Guest id from POST /consumer/guest/request — cart merged when JWT issued

token.description: JWT when is_personal_info=1; null until profile has name

is_personal_info.description: 1 if user has f_name (full JWT issued)

name.description: Full name; split into f_name / l_name

zone_id.description: From GET /consumer/config/zone-id; persisted on user and returned on GET /consumer/whoami

interest.description: JSON array string of category ids

ConsumerFavouriteBody.description: Provide exactly one of food_id or restaurant_id

ConsumerOrderListItem.description: Single row on Orders Running/History/Subscription tabs (Figma card).

image.description: First line item image (Figma card thumbnail)

status_label.description: Badge text — e.g. Confirmed, Handover, Completed

track_order.description: true on Running tab — show Track Order CTA

guest_id.description: Guest user id when not using JWT

coordinates.description: Each pair is [longitude, latitude] — NOT [lat, lng]. After create, formated_coordinates should show lat ~33 and lng ~73 for Islamabad.

zone_id.description: JSON-encoded array of zone ids; use first id (or full list) as query zone_id on catalog APIs

offset.description: Current page number (1-based), from query page

VendorProfileData.description: Vendor row without password, auth_token, or remember_token

firebase_token.description: FCM token for mobile POS / vendor app

fcm_token_web.description: FCM token for Restaurant Web Panel

VendorWhoamiRestaurant.description: Restaurant linked to the vendor (full row; ids as strings)

DeliveryManOrderSummary.description: Order request / active card (GET /orders/latest and GET /orders/active)

delivery_charge.description: Driver delivery fee for this order

restaurant_image_url.description: Full URL (CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_URL + logo/cover) for pickup avatar

customer_image_url.description: Full URL for customer profile image (fallback def.png)

this_week_order_count.description: Orders accepted since start of week (Monday)

this_month_order_count.description: Orders accepted since start of calendar month

todays_earning.description: Sum of original_delivery_charge + dm_tips for today's transactions

DeliveryManMyOrderCard.description: Figma My Orders row — #id, title, item count, date/time, status pill, amount

token.description: Bearer JWT for all protected routes

topic.description: Firebase topic — subscribe for zone/vehicle order pushes

DeliveryManProfileData.description: Delivery man row without password or auth_token (GET whoami / profile)

identity_image.description: JSON array string of R2 paths

NotificationInboxUserItem.description: Order/system push persisted for the app inbox

ConsumerOrderListAuthHeader.name: authorization
ConsumerOrderListAuthHeader.description: Bearer token from POST /consumer/login. For guest orders use query is_guest=true and guest_id instead.

ConsumerOrderTrackContactNumber.name: contact_number
ConsumerOrderTrackContactNumber.description: Required for guest track — must match order delivery_address.contact_person_number

ConsumerOrderTrackIsGuest.name: is_guest
ConsumerOrderTrackIsGuest.description: Pass true with guest_id when not using Bearer JWT

ConsumerOrderListGuestId.name: guest_id
ConsumerOrderListGuestId.description: Required when calling without JWT (with is_guest=true)

ConsumerOrderListSearch.name: search
ConsumerOrderListSearch.description: Figma search — order id or restaurant name

VendorAuthorizationHeader.name: authorization
VendorAuthorizationHeader.description: Bearer JWT from POST /vendor/login (vendor app + restaurant web panel)

ConsumerZoneIdQuery.name: zone_id
ConsumerZoneIdQuery.description: Zone id(s) from GET /consumer/config/zone-id. Single id (2) or JSON array string ([1,2]). Comma-separated also accepted.

ConsumerZoneIdHeader.name: zoneId
ConsumerZoneIdHeader.description: JSON array of zone ids, e.g. `[2]` or `[1,2]`

NotificationInboxDaysDefault7.name: days
NotificationInboxDaysDefault7.description: Include rows from the last N days
